description.value: River Safari operates guided wildlife boat tours through Grizzly Bear Valley in BC's inland temperate rainforest, using native-style catamarans and custom jet boats to explore up to 12 kilometres of glacier-fed rivers and lakes in search of grizzly bears, moose, and eagles. The site also features The Forest Table, a floating-dock restaurant voted one of Canada's most unique dining experiences, and on-site lodge accommodation. Located 1 km off Yellowhead Highway 5 between Jasper and Kamloops, it is a memorable stop for touring cyclists on that corridor.

address.value: 6080 Mud Lake Forest Service Rd, Blue River, BC V0E 1J0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms key OSM data: address, phone (+1 250 673 2309), and website URL all match. The FAQ page explicitly lists 'washrooms' among on-site facilities, and the restaurant (The Forest Table) is well-documented on its own subpage. No bike-specific parking, water refill, or cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: The website front-page header reads 'Blue River Safari' while the footer and OSM both use 'River Safari' — operators may use both names interchangeably; worth confirming official business name.
Operation is seasonal (early May to early October); directory listing should note this context.
Site is 1 km off Yellowhead Hwy 5 on a Forest Service Road — slight detour for cyclists but well-signed per website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating wildlife tour attraction directly on the Yellowhead Highway 5 cycling corridor with confirmed washrooms and food on site — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the Blue River area.
enrichment_extras.notes: FAQ mentions free overnight RV parking in the spacious parking lot (no hookups); this may also accommodate cycle tourists camping. On-site lodge accommodation (River Safari Lodge) is also available.

Café or food on site.detail: The Forest Table Restaurant is on-site on a floating dock; full menu served, voted #3 most unique dining experience in Canada by TheTravel.com

wow_evidence: Guided jet-boat wildlife tours through Grizzly Bear Valley plus a floating-dock restaurant — day-shaping guided experience.
